startingQuestion: What must someone see in ~10 images to understand and be surprised by Crete?

sourcedFactors: Discover-pool seed (CHG-011) — largest Greek island in P2 four-destination pool.
Island story requires west harbour + distinct beach types + inland gorge + Minoan culture + east history + south/east palm anomalies — not Chania/Elafonissi/Spinalonga doubles.
DOC-011 external visual benchmark (Claude/ChatGPT/Grokky Crete) validates breadth gaps: Knossos, Preveli, Vai (+ Falassarna/Loutro/Psiloritis as secondary signals).
Distinctiveness vs Sicily (temples/Etna), Sardinia (nuragic/granite), Albania (Ottoman + Riviera): Crete = lagoons + Venetian harbour + gorge + Minoan palace + palm river/forest.
